verdict.rationale: Penpot is a design platform with an API, MCP server and plugins, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no sandbox, staging or test-mode feature that isolates agent experiments from production data. Self-hosting a separate instance is a deployment option the user would have to set up themselves, not a sandbox capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
